audio_direction.communication_purpose: make the claim legible, preserve uncertainty and leave space for the audience to inspect
audio_direction.mix: Stereo 48 kHz / 24-bit master, integrated -14 LUFS, true peak at or below -1 dBTP; supply voice-only and music-and-effects stems
audio_direction.music: Optional restrained instrumental bed; leave space for evidence and objection wording.
rights: use an owned human recording or a voice model with explicit production rights
use only owned or licensed music and SFX with a stored receipt
do not imitate a real person without documented consent
sound_effects: single subtle transition into the evidence card
no applause, crowd reaction, sales chime, or simulated social proof
audio_direction.voice: Human voice direction: specific, inventive, calm, evidence-first; measured pace; read claim wording exactly.

image_best_of_n.truth_boundary: Mechanical selection occurs only after identity, text, rights and evidence gates; it does not establish taste or publishability.

truth_boundary: This receipt proves production-brief contracts and evidence continuity only. No image, video or audio render, identity match, readability, aesthetic preference or publishability is claimed until the actual media is reviewed.

narrative_script: turn the promise into an inspectable question
show the evidence card and its limitation

platform_edit_script.horizontal_16_9: retain evidence reading time and source marker; no crop may remove claim qualification
platform_edit_script.vertical_9_16: 0–3s promise/product tension; proof before midpoint; burned-in accessible captions; one CTA

shot_script.on_screen_copy: Hypothesis: ProofLaunch can help GTM leaders and founder-led growth teams pursue this outcome—one traceable path from a rights-bound brief to review-ready GTM artifacts—while addressing this problem—fragmented strategy, content, approval and measurement tools that slow execution and obscure accountability. Test that premise through this next step—review the end-to-end evidence pack and join the design-partner cohort—before scaling.
shot_script.visual_direction: Open on an owner-supplied product surface in a split-frame tension against the unresolved decision; do not invent logo, packaging, or product UI.

shot_script.on_screen_copy: What proof would make the next step easier to evaluate?
shot_script.visual_direction: Frame the audience decision as an on-screen question, using no stock testimonial.

shot_script.on_screen_copy: Owner-attested evidence [claim-owner-001]: A governed GTM employee that binds evidence, generation, review, activation and learning without automatic external release.
shot_script.visual_direction: Show a legible evidence card and persistent source marker.

shot_script.on_screen_copy: What would GTM leaders and founder-led growth teams need to inspect before trusting this path?
shot_script.visual_direction: Hold on the unresolved objection with sufficient reading time.

shot_script.on_screen_copy: Review the evidence, then decide whether to join the design-partner cohort.
shot_script.visual_direction: Close with a manual next-step card and no simulated engagement metrics.
